check("业务code为整数且msg为字符串",Number.isInteger(b.code)&&typeof b.msg==="string");

item.name: 09 管理员完整分页范围基准

exec: if(Number(pm.variables.get("t46Stage"))!==8)stopRequest("前置步骤未通过，请从本批起点运行");

check("分页结构有效",Array.isArray(b.rows)&&Number.isInteger(b.total));const page=Number(pm.variables.get("t46Page"));let ids=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("t46ExpectedIds"));ids.push(...b.rows.filter(u=>u.deptId===202).map(u=>u.userId));pm.variables.set("t46ExpectedIds",JSON.stringify(ids));if(page*10<b.total){check("未到末页时仍有记录",b.rows.length>0);pm.variables.set("t46Page",page+1);next(pm.info.requestId);}else{check("基准包含本轮新用户",ids.includes(Number(pm.variables.get("t46UserId"))));check("基准ID无重复",new Set(ids).size===ids.length);
check("业务code为整数且msg为字符串",Number.isInteger(b.code)&&typeof b.msg==="string");

item.name: 12 新用户完整分页获准访问

exec: if(Number(pm.variables.get("t46Stage"))!==11)stopRequest("前置步骤未通过，请从本批起点运行");

check("分页结构有效",Array.isArray(b.rows)&&Number.isInteger(b.total));check("本页记录均属于部门202",b.rows.every(u=>u.deptId===202));let ids=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("t46ActualIds"));ids.push(...b.rows.map(u=>u.userId));pm.variables.set("t46ActualIds",JSON.stringify(ids));const page=Number(pm.variables.get("t46Page"));if(page*10<b.total){check("未到末页时仍有记录",b.rows.length>0);pm.variables.set("t46Page",page+1);next(pm.info.requestId);}else{const expected=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("t46ExpectedIds")).sort((a,b)=>a-b);check("完整ID集合等于管理员本部门基准",JSON.stringify(ids.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b))===JSON.stringify(expected));check("总数及分页无重复",ids.length===b.total&&new Set(ids).size===ids.length);
check("业务code为整数且msg为字符串",Number.isInteger(b.code)&&typeof b.msg==="string");
